mutations.content:
command /spawnbigpig:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        spawn a pig at player
        set {_pig} to last spawned entity
        set max health of {_pig} to 100
        heal {_pig}
        set {_uuid} to uuid of {_pig}
        execute console command "attribute %{_uuid}% minecraft:generic.scale base set 3"
        send "&aSpawned a giant pig!" to player

traces.intent_summary: Update the giant pig script to use the generic.scale attribute command for resizing instead of previous methods.

traces.rationale: Replaced the non-standard 'set scale of' syntax with the requested console command execution using the entity's UUID to ensure compatibility with the server's attribute system.
